newsitem.title: ISRAEL: ECI to issue $100 mln convertible notes.
newsitem.headline: ECI to issue $100 mln convertible notes.

text.p: Israel's ECI Telecom Ltd said it has agreed in principle to issue $100 million of 4.5 percent seven-year convertible subordinated notes in a private placement.
The notes will be convertible into the telecommunications company's ordinary shares six months after closing at $25.00 a share. ECI closed at $19-7/8 on October 15.

Most of the notes issued will be placed with Clal Israel Ltd and Claridge Israel Inc, an investment vehicle of Canadian businessman Charles Bronfman, or other affiliates of the company's principal shareholders.
The transaction is subject to shareholders' approval.
A closing is expected prior to the end of 1996.

ECI chief executive David Rubner said the proceeds would be used for general working capital purposes. "This financing will also provide needed support to enable ECI to grow its business in the Pacific Rim and other emerging markets where customer credit support may be required," he said in a statement.
